references.text: Moses began to proclaim this law, which shows his role as lawgiver for Israel
Moses wrote down this law and gave it to the priests, the sons of Levi, who carried the ark of the Lord's covenant
The law that Moses gave us is an inheritance for the congregation of Jacob
The Lord gave Moses the stone tablets with the law and commandments that God had written
Joshua was commanded to hold fast to the entire law that Moses, the servant of the Lord, had given him
David urged Solomon to keep the Lord's law as it is written in the Law of Moses
Ezra brought forward the Law of Moses which the Lord had given to Israel
The law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ
Moses received living words on Mount Sinai to give them to the Israelites
The law was given through Moses by the hand of angels through a mediator
